text:
derek (Marketing): Quick sync — need to lock Q3 PLG field launch criteria and seller quota ask. Can we aim to finalize by EOD Thu?
anna (PM): Yes. My proposal: must-haves for pilot (GA scope later):
- self-serve onboarding flow
- activation funnel instrumented
- seller enablement kit
- basic billing + trial limits
liz (Solutions Eng): For onboarding we need CSV import + Okta SSO in pilot? CSV import is quick, SSO is more infra. Recommend CSV only for pilot.
sophie (Sales): For sales we need clear target and uplift story. Proposed target: `500 new activated seats` in 90 days from pilot start, ARR motion: `~$200k` ARR expansion. We also need a one-pager for sellers and an email template.
raj (Growth): Experimentation plan: two cohorts — PLG self-serve vs. assisted seller outreach. Metrics: activation %, d7 retention, conversion to paid. Success threshold = activation uplift >= 3x baseline and >12% conversion to paid.
maria (Customer Success): Customers asked for export of usage logs + admin roles. These are showstoppers for a few pilot accounts (Finance and HealthTech). If we can't ship admin roles, we risk losing those accounts.
anna (PM): Ok tradeoffs: ship CSV import + admin roles for pilot, delay SSO and advanced billing. That keeps pilot small but satisfies CS asks.
derek (Marketing): Launch criteria checklist (can we convert to a release checklist?):
```
- Onboarding flow complete ✅
- CSV import ✓
- Admin roles ✓
- Activation tracking in analytics ✓
- Seller enablement kit draft ✓
- Pilot comms and email templates draft ✓
- Support runbook v0 ✗
```
liz (Solutions Eng): I can own support runbook v0, need one week after feature freeze.
sophie (Sales): Need seller quota ask for finance to approve headcount/credits. Requesting: `50 seller seats` for field outreach + `80 vanity licenses` for pilot demos.
raj (Growth): Also want to run a PLG NUDGE experiment in first 14 days — small copy/test + one push — need marketing assets from derek.
derek (Marketing): I’ll prioritize the one-pager + 3 email templates. ETA Tue COB.
maria (Customer Success): Recommend a gating criterion: if any pilot account reports admin blocker during onboarding, pause rollout for that tenant until resolved.
anna (PM): Updated scope for sign-off: Must-haves (CSV, admin roles, tracking, enablement kit, support runbook v0). Nice-to-have: SSO, billing customizations, advanced analytics. If everyone agrees I’ll move this into the release PR and tag owners.
sophie (Sales): Agree. Also please add a short FAQ for sellers about pricing and quotas.
derek (Marketing): noted. Quick note on comms: we should prepare a PLG landing page with an explicit CTA for sellers + tracking UTM for cohorts.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: rollout-beta -> 2026-06-08T15:00:00Z for pilot orgs.
anna (PM): Thanks — I'll open the release PR now and add owners/todo with deadlines. Final ask: approve the seller quota numbers so sales can start internal approvals.
sophie (Sales): Approve `50 seller seats` + `80 demo licenses`.
raj (Growth): Approve experiments and metrics plan.
derek (Marketing): Approve comms plan.
liz (Solutions Eng): Will start the CSV + admin roles work tomorrow.
maria (Customer Success): I'll prepare onboarding playbook snippets for pilot CSMs.
derek (Marketing): Great — we're aligned. I'll circulate a final checklist + timeline after the PR is up. :tada:
